sources.title: Best Way to Run Qwen 3.6 35B MoE Locally: VRAM, Speed, Setup
sources.snippet: Quick Answer: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts model: 35B total parameters, only 3B active per token. UD-Q4_K_M fits entirely on a 24GB card and runs at 157.66 tok/s on our own RTX 3090 — firsthand, headless, no expert offload. UD-Q3_K_M is 16.6 GB and fits a 16GB card with KV offload.
